If the raw fields for a property entry is not an object,
warn and discard all fields.

-- test.glx --
persons:
  someone:
    properties:
      name:
        value: Someone
        # fields requires map[string]any
        fields: "string instead of map of fields"

-- want-errors --
persons\[someone\].Properties.name: all fields discarded: expected object, got string

-- want-catalog.yaml --
persons:
  someone:
    properties:
      name:
        definition:
            label: Name
            value_type: string
        entries:
          - value: StringValue{"Someone"}
